summary: System architecture for the QR Code Conversation Starter platform. When an attendee scans another participant's QR code, an API Gateway authenticates the request and passes signed QR tokens to a QR Resolution Service. The Icebreaker Generation Orchestrator pulls profile and privacy scopes for both attendees, queries a Vector DB for semantic topic overlaps, prompts an LLM with strict privacy guardrails to synthesize tailored conversation starters, caches results in Redis, and asynchronously dispatches telemetry events via a message broker.

nodes.label: Scanner Mobile App / PWA
nodes.description: Attendee client device scanning the target attendee's dynamic or static QR code and rendering icebreakers.

nodes.label: API Gateway & Auth Guard
nodes.description: Authenticates scan requests, applies rate limiting, and validates caller session tokens.

nodes.label: QR Resolver Service
nodes.description: Decodes and verifies cryptographic dynamic QR payloads, mapping them to target user IDs.

nodes.label: Profile & Privacy Service
nodes.description: Applies user visibility filters and extracts public networking interests, bios, and event metadata.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL Profile Store
nodes.description: Persistent relational store for user profiles, event registrations, and privacy permissions.

nodes.label: Redis Cache & Nonce Store
nodes.description: Stores QR nonces to prevent replay attacks and caches generated conversation starters for quick retrieval.

nodes.label: Icebreaker Orchestrator
nodes.description: Aggregates scanner and target profiles, identifies conversational overlaps, and coordinates LLM generation.

nodes.label: Vector Database (Qdrant / pgvector)
nodes.description: Performs cosine similarity searches on profile tags and interest embeddings to locate shared context.

nodes.label: LLM Inference API
nodes.description: Receives prompt templates with redacted overlapping interests and synthesizes polite, context-aware icebreakers.

nodes.label: Telemetry Queue (Kafka / SQS)
nodes.description: Asynchronously ingests scan metrics, engagement telemetry, and starter ratings for analytics.

edges.label: Prompt with profile diff & overlap context

  Orch -->|Semantic Match| VDB
